data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

De Lisle Partners LLP's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in ORN and FSBW.

ORN disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filed October 15, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1402829/000140282926000054/orn-20261012x8k.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
